data.case_title: Bauvoranfrage for garden house rejected by city (Baurechtsamt Beispielheim)
data.title: Rejection of preliminary building inquiry for a garden house (Bauvoranfrage – Ablehnung)
data.summary: The Baurechtsamt (building authority) of Stadt Beispielheim rejected the preliminary building inquiry (Bauvoranfrage) of 12 January 2026 for a 42 m³ garden house in the outer area (Außenbereich), citing § 35 Abs. 2 BauGB. A separate fee notice (Gebührenbescheid) will follow, and an objection (Widerspruch) may be filed within one month of notification.
data.explanation: This letter from the city's building authority (Baurechtsamt) refuses the permission you asked about for building a garden house, because the project would harm public planning interests under building law (§ 35 BauGB). A separate letter setting a processing fee will follow later. If you disagree with the rejection, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing with the city, or with the responsible objection authority, by the deadline shown by the app. If you take no action, the rejection becomes final. Because this letter is now several months old, check first whether that window has already closed; if so, a lawyer specialising in building law could advise on any remaining options.
